name: Bland Bred
audience: Artisan bread enthusiasts, home cooks, and local community members seeking wholesome, handcrafted sourdough without shortcuts.
promise: Simple, unpretentious sourdough baked daily with slow fermentation and honest ingredients.
headline: Simple ingredients. Honest craft.
summary: Bland Bred celebrates authentic slow-fermentation baking. Handcrafted daily with four pure ingredients: organic flour, water, sea salt, and wild starter.
design_direction: Warm, tactile bakery editorial with toasted wheat tones, clean typography, and a rustic sourdough emblem.
